purpose: Convert one accepted axis-aligned rectangular-prism contract into a parameterized SpaceClaim V21 .scscript build artifact.
trigger: A ready rectangular_prism_geometry contract, V21 target, clean-design entry policy, and distinct run-owned output paths are available.

inputs.name: geometry_contract
inputs.description: Accepted primitive parameters, provenance, expected bounds, and volume.

inputs.name: target_environment
inputs.type: SpaceClaim release, API, and Python runtime
inputs.description: Must identify SpaceClaim 2022 R1, API V21, and IronPython 2.7 for this candidate.

inputs.name: run_directory
inputs.description: Destination namespace for distinct model and report outputs.

preconditions: The geometry contract passes the bound schema and host checker with handoff_status ready.
The target is SpaceClaim 2022 R1/API V21/IronPython 2.7 and the entry policy is a new unsaved design with no bodies.
Source, .scscript, model, and report outputs are distinct and any overwrite is explicitly authorized.

outputs.name: scscript_artifact
outputs.description: Executable V21 build package bound to the accepted parameters and run-owned paths.

outputs.name: editable_source
outputs.description: Neighbor source used to package the formal artifact; it is not the file loaded for execution.

postconditions: The formal output is a deterministic .scscript with API metadata 21 and exact UTF-8 neighbor source.
Parameters are centralized and changing valid inputs regenerates the artifact without editing template logic.
The generated script starts from a clean design, re-enumerates bodies, validates bounds, volume, face count, edge count, and name before its only native save.
Static audit passes with BlockBody.Create required and numbered recorded aliases forbidden.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; emits SpaceClaim 2022 R1/API V21/IronPython 2.7 .scscript artifacts and does not launch SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: The emitted script creates topology only when a later execution operation runs it.

ambiguity_checks: The generated script requires exactly one body after creation and rejects any mismatch in bounds, volume, face count, edge count, or name.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: The generated script re-enumerates all bodies immediately after creation and again after naming.

failure_modes.condition: The upstream primitive contract is unresolved or numerically inconsistent.
failure_modes.detection: Run the bound schema and semantic checker before output creation.

failure_modes.condition: The requested target differs from V21/IronPython 2.7.
failure_modes.detection: Compare the build target with this candidate's declared environment.
failure_modes.safe_state: Use generic planning or another version-matched template.

failure_modes.condition: A generated output already exists without explicit force.
failure_modes.detection: Check canonical output paths before writing.

failure_modes.condition: The generated archive lacks required structure or violates static policy.
failure_modes.detection: Run package and audit checks on the exact output.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not hand the artifact to execution.

recovery.action: Return to the geometry contract, repair the responsible value or provenance, and regenerate.
Select a version-matched generic strategy and keep this candidate unused.
Choose a new run-owned destination or explicitly replace only the intended generated output.
Repair the generator or accepted parameters, regenerate both source and package, and rerun the audit.

validation.method: Run the atomic rectangular-prism host tests with two parameter sets and inspect the exact archive members.
validation.expected: Both parameter sets generate parseable sources and deterministic V21 .scscript packages.

validation.method: Audit the generated build package and inspect source ordering.
validation.expected: Creation is semantic, numbered aliases are absent, topology is re-enumerated, and all critical geometry checks precede the single save.

evidence_level.notes: Host evidence covers generation and archive policy. The exact case-001 artifact also completed one controlled V21 run, but runtime behavior belongs to the downstream execution and validation templates and does not by itself activate this generator template.
